title: Genesys VTT
description: Genesys VTT 0.0.164 QA: adds the versioned genesys-dice-renderer-v1 bridge for optional external visual dice renderers such as Genesys Dice Forge. Genesys VTT remains source of truth for narrative RNG/results, while renderers receive exact resolved die types and face indices and may animate them before chat output. Quick Dice Pool, Skill rolls, constructed pools, standard/assisted/opposed engine checks, and non-targeted Weapon checks now await the renderer bridge with automatic fallback. Includes a public integration spec and preserves 0.0.163 narrative symbols, editable Actions, Custom Actions, Character Content Registry, Rule Engine, Extra Activation UX, and Narrative Results Assistant.
